message: 陥没っていうか墜落？
Graded the same day, posted the next. The teachers at Ryuusei Academy work fast.
I figured as much...
Even though I expected it, it's still a bit of a shock.
After we kissed... I was just too distracted.
Not that it's Nanaka's fault. Definitely not.
It's my own fault for not being able to forget about it, even though she told me to.
Still... is there really anyone who could just forget something like that?
Come to think of it, how did Nanaka do?
She usually gets dead-average scores across all subjects and lands right in the middle of the rankings, though.
She's not there.
That's weird...
This is probably... right on the verge... of a failing grade...

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Nanaka.」
Could it be... Nanaka was also thinking about that, just like me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is it... my fault?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's not. Not at all! Look, I've been busy with Student Council stuff! Well, not that I'm using that as an excuse.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you were thinking about it a little... Still, sorry... it really is my fault...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, whatever! You barely scraped into the double digits yourself, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh, whatever. It's not a failing grade, anyway. Water under the bridge!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know what they say, too much is as bad as too little!」

name: Synn
message: 「First of all, it's 'too much is just as bad as too little,' and second, how does that even apply to test scores?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't sweat the small stuff! I'm the kind of woman who leaves the past behind!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
So Nanaka can forget about it, huh...
